name: Blistering Flourish
description: You generate a burst of brilliant light. Any creature other than you within 30 ft. must make a Fortitude save (DC 11 + your Wis modifier) or be dazzled for 1 minute.

name: Burning Blade
description: For the rest of your turn, your melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 fire damage + 1 point per initiator level.

name: Distracting Ember
description: Conjure a Small fire elemental (MM 99) in any space within 30 ft. It remains until the end of your turn and threatens all creatures within its reach, but takes no actions or attacks of opportunity.

name: Flame's Blessing
description: You gain fire resistance based on your ranks in Tumble: resistance 5 at 4–8 ranks, 10 at 9–13 ranks, 20 at 14–18 ranks, or immunity to fire at 19+ ranks.

name: Wind Stride
description: For the rest of your turn, you gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus to your land speed.

name: Burning Brand
description: Your weapon turns into a burning brand for the rest of your turn. The brand increases your reach by 5 feet, and your melee attacks made with the brand deal fire damage equal to your normal melee damage.

name: Fire Riposte
description: When a creature successfully strikes you with a melee or natural weapon, you can make a melee touch attack against it. If it hits, the target takes 4d6 fire damage.

name: Flashing Sun
description: Make a full attack using only melee weapons. You gain one additional attack at your highest attack bonus, but all attacks you make this round take a –2 penalty.

name: Hatchling's Flame
description: You blast forth a 30 ft. cone of fire that deals 2d6 fire damage, with a Reflex save (DC 12 + your Wis modifier) for half damage.

name: Death Mark
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, fire erupts from your enemy's body in a spread centered on the creature, dealing 6d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (including the target), with a Reflex save (DC 13 + your Wis modifier) for half damage. The radius is 5 ft. for Small or smaller targets, 10 ft. for Medium, 20 ft. for Large, 30 ft. for Huge, 40 ft. for Gargantuan, or 50 ft. for Colossal. You are immune to this fire damage.

name: Fan the Flames
description: Make a ranged touch attack against a target within 30 ft. If it hits, the target takes 6d6 fire damage.

name: Holocaust Cloak
description: An adjacent opponent that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 fire damage. This does not harm a creature using a reach weapon to attack you.

name: Zephyr Dance
description: When an opponent attacks you, you can gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against that single attack after the attack is resolved but before damage is determined.

name: Firesnake
description: You cause a 60 ft. line of fire to twist across an area to burn your enemies. Unlike a standard line, a firesnake can bend and twist to hit your foes. A firesnake starts in an adjacent square. It can move up to 60 feet each round. It can move out of your line of sight or line of effect, but you gain no special knowledge of the areas it moves into. If a firesnake moves into a creature's space, that creature takes 6d6 fire damage, with a Reflex save (DC 14 + your Wis modifier) for half damage. A creature can only take damage from the firesnake once in a single round. It makes the saving throw and takes damage the first time that the firesnake touches it. A firesnake must move along the ground. It cannot fly, and it pays the standard movement penalties for difficult terrain and other effects.

name: Searing Blade
description: For the rest of your turn, your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 fire damage + 1 point per initiator level.

name: Searing Charge
description: Make a charge attack. You can fly at your base land speed with perfect maneuverability while charging. If the attack hits, you deal an extra 5d6 fire damage.

name: Dragon's Flame
description: You blast forth a 30 ft. cone of fire that deals 6d6 fire damage. Creatures in the area can attempt Reflex saves (DC 15 + your Wis modifier) for half damage.

name: Leaping Flame
description: When a creature attacks you with a melee or ranged attack, you instantly teleport up to 100 feet into an unoccupied space adjacent to that attacker after resolving the attack. If you cannot move adjacent to the target, the maneuver fails.

name: Lingering Inferno
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 2d6 fire damage, and the target takes an extra 2d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns for 3 rounds.

name: Desert Tempest
description: You move up to your speed. Each time you exit a square adjacent to an enemy, you can first make a single melee attack against that foe. You cannot attack a single enemy more than once with this maneuver.

name: Fiery Assault
description: Your melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 fire damage.

name: Ring of Fire
description: You can move up to twice your speed along continuous, solid ground, leaving a trail of flames. If the trail forms a closed area, an inferno erupts within it, dealing 12d6 fire damage to all creatures inside with a Reflex save (DC 16 + your Wis modifier) for half damage. The inferno erupts only the first time you form a closed area.

name: Inferno Blade
description: For the rest of your turn, your melee attacks deal an extra 3d6 fire damage + 1 point per initiator level.

name: Salamander Charge
description: Make a charge attack. You can change direction freely during the charge and ignore difficult terrain and other creatures in your path. A wall of fire appears in each square along your movement path for up to 5 rounds (or until dismissed as a swift action, or another salamander charge is initiated). A creature standing in the wall takes 6d6 fire damage at the start of its turn, a creature adjacent to the wall takes 3d6 fire damage at the start of its turn, and creatures moving into or through the wall take 6d6 fire damage. The wall does not block line of sight or line of effect.

name: Rising Phoenix
description: You gain a fly speed equal to your land speed with perfect maneuverability, but must remain hovering within 10 feet of a solid or liquid surface. If you hover in place and make a full attack, the column of air deals 3d6 fire damage to creatures adjacent to or within the column (you are unharmed). If you are ever more than 10 feet above a surface, the stance immediately ends and you fall.

name: Wyrm's Flame
description: You blast forth a 30 ft. cone of fire that deals 10d6 fire damage, with a Reflex save (DC 18 + your Wis modifier) for half damage.

name: Inferno Blast
description: You create a 60-ft.-radius burst of fire centered on you that deals 100 fire damage to all other creatures in the area, with a Reflex save (DC 19 + your Wis modifier) for half damage.

name: Crusader's Strike
description: Make a melee attack against an enemy that poses a threat and whose alignment differs from yours on at least one component. If it hits, you or an ally within 10 feet heals 1d6 damage + 1 point per initiator level (maximum +5).

name: Iron Guard's Glare
description: Any opponent you threaten takes a –4 penalty on attack rolls against your other allies.

name: Martial Spirit
description: Each time you hit with a melee attack, you or an ally within 30 feet heals 2 damage.

name: Vanguard Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, all your allies gain a +4 bonus on melee and ranged attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn.

name: Foehammer
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, it automatically overcomes the target's damage reduction and deals an extra 2d6 damage.

name: Shield Block
description: When an opponent attacks an adjacent ally with a melee or ranged attack, you can grant that ally an AC bonus equal to your shield bonus + 4 against that attack. You must choose to use this before knowing whether the attack hits.

name: Defensive Rebuke
description: Until the start of your next turn, each enemy you strike in melee provokes an attack of opportunity from you each time it attacks anyone other than you in melee.

name: Revitalizing Strike
description: Make a melee attack against an enemy that poses a threat and whose alignment differs from yours on at least one component. If it hits, you or an ally within 10 feet heals 3d6 damage + 1 point per initiator level (maximum +10).

name: Thicket of Blades
description: Any opponent you threaten that takes any movement (including a 5-foot step or the withdraw action) provokes an attack of opportunity from you before leaving its square.

name: Divine Surge
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 8d8 damage.

name: Entangling Blade
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 2d6 damage, and the target's speeds (all movement modes) are reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn. A flying creature reduced to 0 ft. fly speed falls.

name: Daunting Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Will save (DC equal to damage dealt) or become shaken for 1 minute.

name: Doom Charge
description: Make a charge attack. If the target is good-aligned, you deal an extra 6d6 damage, and on a hit you gain damage reduction 10/— until the start of your next turn.

name: Law Bearer
description: Make a charge attack. If the target is chaotic-aligned, you gain a +8 bonus on the attack roll and deal an extra 4d6 damage; on a hit against a chaotic target, you gain a +5 bonus to AC and saves until the start of your next turn.

name: Radiant Charge
description: Make a charge attack. If the target is evil-aligned, you deal an extra 6d6 damage, and on a hit you gain damage reduction 10/— until the start of your next turn.

name: Tide of Chaos
description: Make a charge attack. If the target is lawful-aligned, you gain a +8 bonus on the attack roll and deal an extra 4d6 damage; on a hit against a lawful target, you gain total concealment until the start of your next turn.

name: Aura of Chaos
description: When rolling melee damage, whenever a damage die shows its maximum possible result, reroll it and add the result to the damage total. Continue rerolling and adding as long as any die shows its maximum result.

name: Aura of Perfect Order
description: Once per round, you can choose to treat any d20 roll (such as an attack, save, or check) as an 11. You must decide to use this ability immediately before rolling the d20.

name: Aura of Triumph
description: You and each ally within 10 feet heal 4 damage with each successful melee attack either of you makes against an evil target.

name: Aura of Tyranny
description: At the end of your turn, you can deal 2 damage to each willing ally within 10 feet; you heal 1 point of damage for each ally who takes this damage.

name: Rallying Strike
description: Make a melee attack against an enemy that poses a threat and whose alignment differs from yours on at least one component. If it hits, you and all allies within 30 feet heal 3d6 damage + 1 point per initiator level (maximum +15).

name: Castigating Strike
description: Make a melee attack against a foe whose alignment differs from yours on at least one component. If it hits, the target takes an extra 8d6 damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 17 + your Cha modifier) or take a –2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 minute. In addition, all enemies within a 30-ft.-radius burst of the target must make a Fortitude save, taking 5d6 damage and a –2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 minute (a successful save halves damage and negates the penalty).

name: Shield Counter
description: When an opponent you threaten declares an attack (before resolving it), you can make a shield bash attack at a –2 penalty against that opponent. If your shield bash hits, the opponent's attack automatically misses.

name: Divine Surge, Greater
description: Choose a number X between 0 and your initiator level. Take X Constitution damage. Make a melee attack with a +X bonus on the attack roll. If it hits, you deal an extra 6d8 damage, plus (2 times X)d8 damage. You are flat-footed until the start of your next turn.

name: Immortal Fortitude
description: When damage would reduce you to 0 or fewer hit points, you can make a Fortitude save (DC equal to negative HP total). On a success, you remain alive and conscious at 1 hit point; on a failure, you die or fall unconscious as normal. After 3 saving throw attempts, this stance immediately ends. This does not protect against non-hit-point death effects, petrification, or paralysis.

name: Strike of Righteous Vitality
description: Make a melee attack against an enemy that poses a threat and whose alignment differs from yours on at least one component. If it hits, you or one ally within 10 feet gains the benefit of a *heal* spell (CL equals your character level).

name: Moment of Perfect Mind
description: When required to make a Will save, you can make a Concentration check instead and use the result as your save. A natural 1 on the check is not an automatic failure. You must choose to use this before rolling the save.

name: Sapphire Nightmare Blade
description: Make a Concentration check against the target's AC, then make a melee attack. If the check succeeds, the target is flat-footed against the attack and you deal an extra 1d6 damage. If the check fails, the attack takes a –2 penalty and deals normal damage.

name: Stance of Clarity
description: At the start of your turn, choose a single opponent. You gain a +2 insight bonus to AC against that foe, but take a –2 penalty to AC against all other opponents.

name: Action Before Thought
description: When required to make a Reflex save, you can make a Concentration check instead and use the result as your save. A natural 1 on the check is not an automatic failure. You must choose to use this before rolling the save.

name: Emerald Razor
description: Make a melee attack, as a touch attack.

name: Insightful Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal damage equal to a Concentration check result instead of normal damage (Strength, weapon enhancements, and extra damage modifiers do not apply).

name: Mind Over Body
description: When required to make a Fortitude save, you can make a Concentration check instead and use the result as your save. A natural 1 on the check is not an automatic failure. You must choose to use this before rolling the save.

name: Pearl of Black Doubt
description: Each time an opponent misses you with a melee attack, you gain a cumulative +2 dodge bonus to AC against all attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Bounding Assault
description: Make a charge attack without the straight-line movement restriction.

name: Mind Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Will save (DC 14 + your Str modifier) or take 1d4 Wisdom damage.

name: Ruby Nightmare Blade
description: Make a Concentration check against the target's AC, then make a melee attack. If the check succeeds, the attack deals double normal melee damage. If the check fails, the attack takes a –2 penalty and deals normal damage.

name: Disrupting Blow
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Will save (DC 15 + your Str modifier) or be unable to take any actions for 1 round (it can still make attacks of opportunity, but cannot take immediate actions until its next turn).

name: Hearing the Air
description: You gain blindsense out to 30 feet and a +5 insight bonus on Listen checks.

name: Rapid Counter
description: When a foe provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you can make an immediate melee attack against that foe. This does not count against your attacks of opportunity for the round.

name: Insightful Strike, Greater
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal damage equal to twice a Concentration check result instead of normal damage (Strength, weapon enhancements, and extra damage modifiers do not apply).

name: Moment of Alacrity
description: At the end of this round, add 20 to your initiative count, and change your place in the turn order accordingly.

name: Avalanche of Blades
description: Make a melee attack against a single foe. If it hits, you can make another attack against that foe at a –4 penalty. If that hits, you can make another attack at a –8 penalty, continuing with an additional cumulative –4 penalty per attack until you miss or the target drops to –1 hit points or fewer.

name: Quicksilver Motion
description: Take a move action.

name: Diamond Defense
description: When required to make a saving throw, you can gain a bonus on that save equal to your initiator level. You must choose to use this before rolling the save.

name: Diamond Nightmare Blade
description: Make a Concentration check against the target's AC, then make a melee attack. If the check succeeds, the attack deals quadruple normal melee damage. If the check fails, the attack takes a –2 penalty and deals normal damage.

name: Stance of Alacrity
description: The first counter you initiate each round doesn't cost an immediate action.

name: Time Stands Still
description: Make two full attacks, in succession.

name: Punishing Stance
description: You deal an extra 1d6 damage with all melee attacks, but take a –2 penalty to AC.

name: Steel Wind
description: Make two melee attacks, each against a different foe you threaten.

name: Steely Strike
description: Make a melee attack with a +4 bonus. All enemies other than the target gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls against you for 1 round.

name: Disarming Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt to disarm the target without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-disarm.

name: Wall of Blades
description: When an opponent attacks you with a melee or ranged attack, you can make a melee attack roll with your weapon to oppose the attack. You use the higher of your AC or attack roll against that attack. You cannot use this if denied your Dexterity bonus to AC.

name: Absolute Steel
description: You gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus to your speed. If you move at least 10 feet during your turn, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Exorcism of Steel
description: Make a sunder attack against an opponent's manufactured weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity. If successful, the wielder takes a –4 penalty on melee damage rolls for 1 minute (Will save DC 13 + your Str modifier halves).

name: Iron Heart Surge
description: Select one spell, effect, or condition currently affecting you with a duration of 1 or more rounds. That effect ends immediately, and you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

name: Lightning Recovery
description: When a melee attack you make misses, you can reroll the attack roll with a +2 bonus.

name: Mithral Tornado
description: Make a melee attack at a +2 bonus against every adjacent opponent.

name: Dancing Blade Form
description: During your turn, your reach with melee attacks increases by 5 feet. This doesn't stack with other reach-increasing maneuvers.

name: Dazing Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 15 + your Str modifier) or be dazed for 1 round.

name: Iron Heart Focus
description: When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must accept the second result.

name: Iron Heart Endurance
description: If you have half or fewer of your full normal hit points remaining, you heal hit points equal to twice your character level.

name: Manticore Parry
description: When an enemy attacks you with an armed melee attack, you can oppose it with a melee attack roll. If your roll beats the enemy's attack roll, the strike is deflected to an adjacent target of your choice using the enemy's attack roll. You must choose to use this before knowing if the attack hits.

name: Finishing Move
description: Make a melee attack. It deals an extra 4d6 damage, or extra 6d6 damage if the target is below full HP, or extra 14d6 damage if the target is at or below half HP.

name: Scything Blade
description: If the first melee attack you make during your turn hits, you can immediately make a free melee attack at your highest attack bonus against a different enemy you threaten.

name: Adamantine Hurricane
description: Make two melee attacks at a +4 bonus against each adjacent opponent you threaten.

name: Lightning Throw
description: Make a melee attack roll and throw your melee weapon in a 30-ft. line. Each creature in the line takes your normal melee damage plus an extra 12d6 damage, with a Reflex save (DC equal to your attack roll) for half damage. Your weapon returns to your hand at the end of the round.

name: Supreme Blade Parry
description: You gain damage reduction 5/— against any opponent that does not catch you flat-footed, provided you are proficient with your weapon (or have Improved Unarmed Strike if unarmed).

name: Strike of Perfect Clarity
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 100 damage.

name: Counter Charge
description: When a creature charges you, you can make an opposed Strength or Dexterity check immediately before it attacks (+4 bonus if you are larger for Str, or +4 bonus if smaller for Dex). If you win, the attack is negated and you move the creature up to 2 squares away. If you fail, the creature gains an additional +2 bonus on its charge attack.

name: Mighty Throw
description: Make a melee touch attack. If it hits, make a trip attempt with a +4 bonus on the ability check, without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-trip. If successful, you throw the target up to 10 feet away into an empty space; it lands prone. Thrown foes can pass through occupied squares and do not provoke attacks of opportunity during the throw.

name: Step of the Wind
description: You ignore movement and skill check penalties from difficult terrain. Against opponents in difficult terrain, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls and a +4 bonus on bull rush and trip checks (both to attempt and to resist).

name: Baffling Defense
description: When an opponent attacks you, you can make a Sense Motive check and use the result instead of your AC against that attack. You must choose to use this before knowing if the attack hits.

name: Clever Positioning
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Reflex save (DC 12 + your Dex modifier) or swap positions with you.

name: Devastating Throw
description: Move at least 15 feet, then make a melee touch attack. If it hits, make a trip attempt with a +4 bonus on the ability check, without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-trip. If successful, you throw the target up to 10 feet away (plus 5 ft. per 5 points you beat the check by); it lands prone and takes 2d6 damage.

name: Feigned Opening
description: When an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you (before resolving it), you can initiate this maneuver. If the attack misses, the enemy provokes an attack of opportunity from you; if it hits, the enemy provokes an attack of opportunity from all allies who threaten her.

name: Giant Killing Style
description: You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls and a +4 bonus on damage rolls against opponents of a larger size category than yours.

name: Comet Throw
description: Make a melee touch attack. If it hits, make a trip attempt with a +4 bonus on the ability check, without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-trip. If successful, you throw the target up to 10 feet into an empty space (plus 5 ft. per 5 points you beat the check by); it lands prone and takes 4d6 damage. If thrown into an occupied square, the second creature also takes 4d6 damage and falls prone (Reflex save DC 14 + your Str modifier halves damage and negates knockdown), and the thrown target lands in an adjacent empty space.

name: Strike of the Broken Shield
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 4d6 damage and the target must make a Reflex save (DC 14 + your Str modifier) or become flat-footed until the start of its next turn.

name: Mirrored Pursuit
description: When an adjacent opponent moves, you can immediately move up to your speed to any square adjacent to her as soon as she stops moving. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Shifting Defense
description: Each time an opponent attacks you, you can spend an attack of opportunity to take an immediate 5-foot step. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Soaring Throw
description: Make a melee touch attack. If it hits, make a trip attempt with a +4 bonus on the ability check, without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-trip. If successful, you throw the target up to 20 feet away into an empty space (plus 5 ft. per 5 points you beat the check by); it lands prone and takes 8d6 damage. Thrown foes do not provoke attacks of opportunity during the throw.

name: Stalking Shadow
description: When an adjacent opponent moves, you can take an immediate 5-foot step into a space it just vacated. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Ballista Throw
description: Make a melee touch attack. If it hits, make a trip attempt with a +4 bonus on the ability check, without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-trip. If successful, you throw the target in a 60-foot line; the target and all creatures in the line take 6d6 damage and the target lands prone at the end of the line.

name: Scorpion Parry
description: When an opponent attacks you, you can make an opposed attack roll. If your result is higher, you redirect the attack to an adjacent creature within the attacker's reach using the attacker's original attack roll.

name: Hydra Slaying Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target cannot make a full attack on its next turn.

name: Fool's Strike
description: When an enemy attacks you, you can make an opposed attack roll. If your result is higher, the enemy deals its normal attack damage to itself.

name: Ghostly Defense
description: Whenever an opponent's attack misses you due to a miss chance (such as concealment), you can redirect that attack to another eligible target adjacent to you using the original attack roll result. You cannot use this if flat-footed.

name: Tornado Throw
description: Move at least 10 feet, then make a melee touch attack. If it hits, make a trip attempt with a +4 bonus on the ability check, without provoking attacks of opportunity or risking counter-trip. If successful, you throw the target up to 10 feet away plus 5 ft. per 5 points you beat the check by. They land prone and takes 2d6 damage plus 1d6 per 5 points you beat the check by. The thrown foe does not provoke attacks of opportunity for being thrown. Repeat this process any number of times, moving a maximum total of double your speed.

name: Child of Shadow
description: If you move at least 10 feet during your turn, you gain concealment against all attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Clinging Shadow Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 1d6 damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 11 + your Wis modifier) or suffer a 20% miss chance on all attacks for 1 round.

name: Island of Blades
description: While both you and an ally are adjacent to the same creature, you both gain the benefit of flanking that creature.

name: Shadow Blade Technique
description: Make a melee attack, rolling 2d20. If you choose the higher roll, resolve the attack normally; if you choose the lower roll (or both rolls match), you deal an extra 1d6 cold damage on a hit.

name: Cloak of Deception
description: You turn invisible (as greater invisibility, PH 245) until the end of your turn.

name: Drain Vitality
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + your Wis modifier) or take 2 Constitution damage.

name: Shadow Jaunt
description: You teleport up to 50 feet to any unoccupied space to which you have line of sight and line of effect.

name: Assassin's Stance
description: You gain the sneak attack ability (+2d6 damage); if you already have sneak attack, this bonus damage stacks.

name: Dance of the Spider
description: You gain a climb speed of 20 feet and can move on vertical surfaces and ceilings with at least one hand free without Climb checks, retaining your Dexterity bonus to AC (cannot run).

name: Shadow Garrote
description: Make a ranged touch attack against a living creature within 60 ft. If it hits, you deal 5d6 damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 13 + your Wis modifier) or become flat-footed until the start of its next turn.

name: Strength Draining Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you also deal 4 Strength damage (Fortitude save DC 13 + your Wis modifier halves).

name: Hand of Death
description: Make a melee touch attack against a flat-footed opponent. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + your Wis modifier) or be paralyzed for 1d3 rounds.

name: Obscuring Shadow Veil
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 5d6 damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + your Wis modifier) or suffer a 50% miss chance on all attacks for 1 round.

name: Bloodletting Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you also deal 4 Constitution damage (Fortitude save DC 15 + your Wis modifier reduces to 2 points).

name: Step of the Dancing Moth
description: You gain a land speed of 20 feet (cannot run) and walk up to 5 feet above the ground, ignoring terrain features projecting 5 feet or less (such as difficult terrain, liquid, or lava) and ignoring penalties for moving quickly while hiding or moving silently.

name: Ghost Blade
description: Make a melee attack. The target is flat-footed against this attack.

name: Shadow Noose
description: Make a ranged touch attack against a flat-footed living creature within 60 ft. If it hits, you deal 8d6 damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 16 + your Wis modifier) or be stunned for 1 round.

name: Shadow Stride
description: You teleport up to 50 feet to any unoccupied space to which you have line of sight and line of effect.

name: Stalker in the Night
description: Move up to your speed and make a single melee attack at any point during your movement. If hidden before moving, you retain your previous Hide and Move Silently checks for this movement and attack.

name: Death in the Dark
description: Make a melee attack against a flat-footed opponent vulnerable to critical hits. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 17 + your Wis modifier), taking an extra 15d6 damage on a failed save or an extra 5d6 damage on a successful save.

name: Shadow Blink
description: You teleport up to 50 feet to any unoccupied space to which you have line of sight and line of effect.

name: Balance On the Sky
description: You gain the benefit of air walk (PH 196) on yourself while maintaining this stance with at least one hand empty (moving upward costs 10 ft. movement per 5 ft. elevation). If this stance ends in midair, you fall.

name: Enervating Shadow Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 18 + your Wis modifier) or gain 1d4 negative levels; you gain 5 temporary hit points per negative level bestowed until the end of the encounter.

name: One With Shadow
description: You become incorporeal along with your gear until the start of your next turn.

name: Five-Shadow Creeping Ice Enervation Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 15d6 damage, and roll d20 for an effect (lasts 1d6 rounds): 1–7 deals 2d6 Dex damage and reduces speed to 0 ft.; 8–14 deals 2d6 Str damage and a –6 penalty on attack rolls and Concentration checks; 15–20 deals 2d6 Dex, 2d6 Str, and 2d6 Con damage. A Fortitude save (DC 19 + your Wis modifier) negates the special effect, negates the Con damage, and halves the Dex and Str damage.

name: Charging Minotaur
description: Make a bull rush attack as part of a charge without provoking attacks of opportunity. If your Strength check exceeds the opponent's result, you deal 2d6 + Str modifier bludgeoning damage in addition to pushing the target back (you do not need to follow).

name: Stone Bones
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you gain damage reduction 5/adamantine for 1 round.

name: Stonefoot Stance
description: You gain a +2 bonus on Strength checks and a +2 bonus to AC against creatures larger than you. Ends immediately if you move more than 5 feet.

name: Mountain Hammer
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 2d6 damage and overcome damage reduction and hardness.

name: Stone Vise
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 1d6 damage and the target, if on the ground, must make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + your Str modifier) or its speed drops to 0 ft. for 1 round.

name: Bonecrusher
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 4d6 damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 13 + your Str modifier) or rolls to confirm critical hits against it gain a +10 bonus until its hit points are fully restored. (Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this effect.)

name: Crushing Weight of the Mountain
description: You gain the ability to constrict for 2d6 + 1-1/2 times your Str bonus damage on a successful grapple check.

name: Roots of the Mountain
description: You gain damage reduction 2/—, a +10 bonus on grapple checks and checks to resist bull rush, overrun, and trip, and creatures moving through your space or threatened area take a –10 penalty on Tumble checks. Ends immediately if you move more than 5 feet.

name: Stone Dragon's Fury
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits a construct or object, you deal an extra 4d6 damage. Can be used in conjunction with a sunder attempt.

name: Bonesplitting Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal normal damage plus 2 Constitution damage.

name: Boulder Roll
description: When you make an overrun attack, you gain a +4 bonus on your Strength check, do not provoke attacks of opportunity for moving or overrunning, and cannot be knocked prone if you fail.

name: Overwhelming Mountain Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 2d6 damage and the target, if on the ground, must make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + your Str modifier) or lose its move action for 1 round.

name: Elder Mountain Hammer
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 6d6 damage and overcome damage reduction and hardness.

name: Giant's Stance
description: You deal damage with weapons and unarmed strikes as if one size category larger (maximum Large). Ends immediately if you move more than 5 feet.

name: Mountain Avalanche
description: You can move up to double your speed and trample creatures of your size or smaller, dealing 2d6 + 1-1/2 times your Str bonus damage once per creature when you enter all of its space. If you enter only part of a creature's space, it can make an attack of opportunity against you or a Reflex save (DC 15 + your Str modifier) for half damage.

name: Crushing Vise
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 4d6 damage, and if the target is on the ground, its speed drops to 0 ft. for 1 round.

name: Iron Bones
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you gain damage reduction 10/adamantine for 1 round.

name: Irresistible Mountain Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 4d6 damage and the target, if on the ground, must make a Fortitude save (DC 16 + your Str modifier) or be unable to take a standard action for 1 round.

name: Ancient Mountain Hammer
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 12d6 damage and overcome damage reduction and hardness.

name: Colossus Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 6d6 damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 17 + your Str modifier, with a –2 penalty for smaller creatures or +2 bonus for larger creatures) or be hurled 1d4 squares away from you and knocked prone without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Adamantine Bones
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you gain damage reduction 20/adamantine for 1 round.

name: Earthstrike Quake
description: All creatures standing on the ground within a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you (excluding yourself) must make a Reflex save (DC 18 + your Str modifier) or fall prone; creatures actively casting a spell must succeed on a Concentration check (DC 20 + spell level) or lose the spell.

name: Strength of Stone
description: You are immune to critical hits. Ends immediately if you move more than 5 feet.

name: Mountain Tombstone Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal 2d6 Constitution damage in addition to normal damage.

name: Blood in the Water
description: You gain a cumulative +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls each time you score a critical hit; this bonus lasts until 1 minute passes without scoring a critical hit.

name: Hunter's Sense
description: You gain the scent special ability (MM 314).

name: Sudden Leap
description: Make a Jump check and move the distance indicated in a straight line (provokes attacks of opportunity as normal).

name: Wolf Fang Strike
description: While wielding two weapons (or a weapon and unarmed strike), make a melee attack with each weapon against the same opponent with a –2 penalty on each attack roll.

name: Claw at the Moon
description: Make a Jump check (DC equal to the target's AC). If successful, make a melee attack that deals an extra 2d6 damage and gains a +4 bonus on rolls to confirm critical hits; on a failure, you make a normal melee attack.

name: Rabid Wolf Strike
description: Make a melee attack with a +4 bonus. If it hits, you deal an extra 2d6 damage. You take a –4 penalty to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Flesh Ripper
description: Make a melee attack against a creature vulnerable to critical hits. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 13 + your Str modifier) or take a –4 penalty on attacks and to AC for 1 round (or for rounds equal to your weapon's critical multiplier on a critical hit).

name: Leaping Dragon Stance
description: You gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus on Jump checks, and all your jumps are treated as running jumps.

name: Soaring Raptor Strike
description: Against a foe of a larger size category than yours, make a Jump check (DC equal to its AC). If successful, make a melee attack with a +4 bonus dealing an extra 6d6 damage; on a failure, the maneuver is expended with no attack.

name: Wolverine Stance
description: You can attack a grappling foe with any one-handed weapon without the –4 grapple penalty, and gain a +4 bonus on damage rolls against grappling foes of a larger size category.

name: Death from Above
description: Make a DC 20 Jump check against an adjacent foe. If successful, you land in an adjacent square within 20 ft. and make a melee attack dealing an extra 4d6 damage against a flat-footed opponent; on a failure, you remain in your space and make a normal melee attack.

name: Fountain of Blood
description: When you reduce a living opponent in your threatened area to –1 or fewer hit points, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to it and all enemies within 30 ft. must make a Will save (DC 14 + your Str modifier, +1 per foe dropped this turn) or be shaken for 1 minute.

name: Dancing Mongoose
description: You make one additional attack with each weapon you wield (maximum two extra attacks) at your highest attack bonus against the same opponent this turn.

name: Pouncing Charge
description: Make a charge attack, but make a full attack instead of a single attack at the end of the charge. The +2 charge bonus applies to all attack rolls.

name: Rabid Bear Strike
description: Make a melee attack with a +4 bonus. If it hits, you deal an extra 10d6 damage. You take a –4 penalty to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Wolf Climbs the Mountain
description: Against a foe of a larger size category than yours, enter its space without provoking an attack of opportunity and make a melee attack dealing an extra 5d6 damage. While you remain in its space, you gain cover against all attacks; if the target moves, it provokes an attack of opportunity from you.

name: Hamstring Attack
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, the target takes normal damage, 1d8 Dexterity damage, and a –10-foot penalty to speed for 1 minute (Fortitude save DC 17 + your Str modifier halves Dex damage and speed penalty).

name: Prey On the Weak
description: Whenever an opponent within 10 feet of you drops to –1 or fewer hit points, you can make an attack of opportunity against any opponent within your threatened area.

name: Swooping Dragon Strike
description: Make a Jump check to jump over an opponent. If successful, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for moving, your melee attack against the target deals an extra 10d6 damage against its flat-footed AC, and it must make a Fortitude save (DC equal to your Jump check result) or be stunned for 1 round. On a failed Jump check, you provoke attacks of opportunity and make a normal melee attack.

name: Girallon Windmill Flesh Rip
description: While wielding two or more weapons, whenever you hit a creature multiple times this turn you deal rend damage based on the number of attacks that hit it: 2 hits deal 8d6, 3 hits deal 10d6, 4 hits deal 12d6, 5 hits deal 14d6, 6 hits deal 16d6, 7 hits deal 18d6, or 8+ hits deal 20d6.

name: Raging Mongoose
description: You make two additional attacks with each weapon you wield (maximum four extra attacks) at your highest attack bonus this turn.

name: Wolf Pack Tactics
description: Each time you make a successful melee attack, you can move 5 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity from that creature (up to your current speed per round).

name: Feral Death Blow
description: Make a Jump check against an adjacent foe (DC equal to its AC). If successful, make a melee attack against the flat-footed target; if it deals damage, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 19 + your Str modifier) or be instantly slain (if immune to critical hits, or on a successful save, it instead takes an extra 20d6 damage). On a failed Jump check, make a normal melee attack.

name: Bolstering Voice
description: Allies within 60 ft. who can hear you gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saves (+4 against fear effects).

name: Douse the Flames
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal normal damage and the target cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.

name: Leading the Attack
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, your allies gain a +4 morale bonus on attack rolls against that target for 1 round.

name: Leading the Charge
description: Allies within 60 ft. who can hear you gain a bonus on charge attack damage rolls equal to your initiator level.

name: Battle Leader's Charge
description: Make a charge attack without provoking attacks of opportunity for moving; if it hits, you deal an extra 10 damage.

name: Tactical Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 2d6 damage, and each ally adjacent to the target can immediately take a 5-foot step without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Lion's Roar
description: When you reduce an opponent below 0 hit points, you and allies within 60 ft. gain a +5 morale bonus on damage rolls for 1 round.

name: Tactics of the Wolf
description: When you flank a foe, you and allies flanking the foe with you gain a bonus on damage rolls against that opponent equal to 1/2 your initiator level.

name: White Raven Tactics
description: Choose an ally within 10 ft. Her initiative count immediately becomes your initiative count – 1; if she has already acted this round, she can act again on her new count.

name: Covering Strike
description: Any foe you hit with a melee attack this turn cannot make attacks of opportunity for 3 rounds (maximum once per encounter per target).

name: White Raven Strike
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 4d6 damage and the target is flat-footed until the start of its next turn.

name: Flanking Maneuver
description: Make a melee attack against a creature you and one or more allies are flanking. If it hits, each flanking ally who can see you can immediately make a melee attack against that creature.

name: Press the Advantage
description: You can take a second 5-foot step immediately after taking your first 5-foot step for the round (or make a single 5-foot step into difficult terrain, which prevents the second step).

name: Order Forged From Chaos
description: Allies within 30 ft. can immediately take a move action to move up to their speed (this movement provokes attacks of opportunity and does not count toward skirmish or minimum movement abilities).

name: War Leader's Charge
description: Make a charge attack without provoking attacks of opportunity for moving; if it hits, you deal an extra 35 damage.

name: Clarion Call
description: When a melee attack you make during your turn reduces a foe below 0 hit points, all allies within 60 ft. who see and hear you can immediately either make one melee attack at their highest attack bonus or take a single move action.

name: Swarming Assault
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, any ally threatening the target can immediately make a melee attack against it.

name: Swarm Tactics
description: While adjacent to one or more opponents, allies within 60 ft. gain a +5 bonus on attack rolls against those opponents.

name: White Raven Hammer
description: Make a melee attack. If it hits, you deal an extra 6d6 damage and the target is stunned for 1 round.

name: War Master's Charge
description: You charge an opponent without provoking attacks of opportunity for moving, dealing an extra 50 damage, and all allies within 30 ft. can also charge this target as an immediate action (dealing an extra 25 damage and without provoking attacks of opportunity). You and charging allies gain a cumulative +2 bonus on charge attack rolls per charging creature; if struck by you and at least one ally, the target is stunned for 1 round.
